north_star: Turn a selected Apple Mail message into a trustworthy Todoist action in one uninterrupted keystroke.
wedge: A Raycast command that creates a Todoist Inbox task through the API, preserves a direct Apple Mail link, and confirms success with a lightweight HUD.
target_user: macOS professionals who handle correspondence in Apple Mail and organize commitments in Todoist.
core_promise: Select mail, invoke once, and receive exactly one traceable Todoist task without changing the email.
product_principles: Mail remains untouched: task creation never archives, moves, flags, or deletes the source message.
Private by default: credentials stay in macOS Keychain and message bodies are excluded unless a future explicit feature requires them.
One action, one outcome: direct API creation is idempotent and visibly confirmed.
Failure is honest: uncertain delivery is reconciled before any retry can duplicate work.
non_goals: Saving or enriching messages in JSONL Vault.
Managing, archiving, moving, or deleting Apple Mail messages.
AI-generated summaries, due dates, projects, or priorities in the initial product.
Providing a cross-platform email client integration.
success_metrics: A selected message creates exactly one Todoist task with a working Mail link and success HUD in under three seconds on a healthy connection.
Repeated or uncertain submissions do not create duplicate Todoist tasks.
A repository secret scan and fixtures prove that tokens, message bodies, addresses, and live mail identifiers never enter Git.
